label: Ensemble Kalman filter on WaterSim (HBV + snow), joint state-parameter + Mondrian conformal
numpy_only_reason: wraps enkf_watersim: runs the vendored WaterSim kernels (HBV step, degree-day snow) inside a numba-compiled filter loop; numba compiles at first call (~3 s), no cache files written (cache=False). A pure-numpy port would be ~100x slower (daily loop x 32 members x 4,000+ days).

compute.notes: conformal fit only (dev predictions of enkf_watersim + shifts); the base arm is not retrained

feature_engineering: none beyond enkf_watersim's; the conformal offset uses static[11] (mean forcing P) and the class list (strata)
rule: No ladder: one conformal fit on dev residuals (method fixed in advance). Reported raw vs conformal.

rungs.change: Mondrian split-conformal bands (asymmetric CQR, log space, strata snow/arid/humid/other) fitted on dev residuals
rungs.why: the only rung; dev coverage (LOBO) gauged_L1 0.93, gauged_L3 0.92, gauged_L7 0.91
